title: Snowman Isle
safeHtml:
'''Snowman Isle''' is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is connected to Hatace Island with Snowman Bridge.

Location

'''Snowman Isle''' is located at the east of West Metropolis Archipelago and the southwest of Hatace Island. This isle is named after the fact that this isle looks like a snowman.

Transport

External Access

  • Snowman Bridge (Connect to Hatace Island)

Railways

As the Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development forbids any motor roads and railways on isles, plans for the Hatace Island Light Rail to connect to this isle were scrapped. As a result, the Snowman Bridge remains the only external access to and from this isle.
